description:
Cross App Access (draft-ietf-oauth-identity-assertion-authz-grant). An agent presents an identity assertion authorization grant (ID-JAG) minted by a trusted identity provider through the jwt-bearer grant type :

POST /token HTTP/1.1
grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&assertion=|ID-JAG|

grantType.title: Grant Type
grantType.description: OAuth 2.0 grant type. The client uses an extension grant type by specifying the grant type value of the "grant_type" parameter of the token endpoint.

userBindingCriteria.title: User binding rules
userBindingCriteria.description: Used when "Check user" is enabled. Each rule matches a user profile attribute against an expression evaluated over the verified assertion claims, exposed as token (e.g. {#token['email']}). All rules must match, and exactly one user must match them. Leave empty to bind the user whose external id is the assertion subject and whose source is the identity provider trusted for the assertion issuer.

attribute.title: User attribute
attribute.description: User profile attribute to match (e.g. emails.value, userName, additionalInformation.employee_id)

expression.title: Expression
expression.description: Expression over the verified assertion claims (e.g. {#token['email']})
